sloka: स मे वध्यः खलु भवेत् कथाद्वन्द्वं समीरितम् ।ऋषेर्मम च सौमित्रे पश्येद्वा शृणुयाच्च यः ।। ७.१०३.१५ ॥
transliteration: sa me vadhyaḥ khalu bhavet kathādvandvaṁ samīritam ।ṛṣermama ca saumitre paśyedvā śṛṇuyācca yaḥ ।। 7.103.15 ॥

translations.english: Rama declared that anyone who sees or hears the private conversation between him and the sage would indeed be worthy of death.
